{"script":"set -e
# 1. Create workspace
mkdir -p temp_inspect

# 2. Copy target file
cp /root/matrix.txt temp_inspect/matrix_copy.txt

# 3. Extract and save original file metadata (size, modification time, permissions)
stat --printf 'size:%s\nmtime:%y\nperm:%a\n' temp_inspect/matrix_copy.txt > temp_inspect/matrix_copy.meta

# 4. Produce normalized version: normalize line endings to LF and trim trailing empty lines
# Use perl to handle CRLF->LF and remove trailing blank lines (leave one final newline)
perl -0777 -pe 's/\r\n?/\n/g; s/\n+\z/\n/' temp_inspect/matrix_copy.txt > temp_inspect/matrix_normalized.txt

# 5. Save head and tail previews (first/last 50 lines)
head -n 50 temp_inspect/matrix_normalized.txt > temp_inspect/preview_head.txt || true
tail -n 50 temp_inspect/matrix_normalized.txt > temp_inspect/preview_tail.txt || true

# 6. Compute and record checksums (SHA256)
sha256sum temp_inspect/matrix_copy.txt | awk '{print $1}' > temp_inspect/matrix_copy.checksum
sha256sum temp_inspect/matrix_normalized.txt | awk '{print $1}' > temp_inspect/matrix_normalized.checksum

# Also record metadata for normalized file for comparison
stat --printf 'size:%s\nmtime:%y\nperm:%a\n' temp_inspect/matrix_normalized.txt > temp_inspect/matrix_normalized.meta

# 7. Compare checksums and metadata, write concise verification report
cc1=$(cat temp_inspect/matrix_copy.checksum)
cc2=$(cat temp_inspect/matrix_normalized.checksum)

{
  echo "Verification report:";
  if [ "$cc1" = "$cc2" ]; then
    echo "- checksum: MATCH";
  else
    echo "- checksum: DIFFER (matrix_copy:$cc1 vs matrix_normalized:$cc2)";
  fi

  # compare metadata fields
  echo "- metadata differences:";
  # read values
  size1=$(awk -F: '/^size:/ {print $2}' temp_inspect/matrix_copy.meta)
  mtime1=$(awk -F: '/^mtime:/ {print substr($0,index($0,":")+1)}' temp_inspect/matrix_copy.meta)
  perm1=$(awk -F: '/^perm:/ {print $2}' temp_inspect/matrix_copy.meta)

  size2=$(awk -F: '/^size:/ {print $2}' temp_inspect/matrix_normalized.meta)
  mtime2=$(awk -F: '/^mtime:/ {print substr($0,index($0,":")+1)}' temp_inspect/matrix_normalized.meta)
  perm2=$(awk -F: '/^perm:/ {print $2}' temp_inspect/matrix_normalized.meta)

  diff_flag=0
  if [ "$size1" = "$size2" ]; then
    echo "  size: MATCH ($size1)";
  else
    echo "  size: DIFFER (original:$size1 normalized:$size2)"; diff_flag=1;
  fi
  if [ "$mtime1" = "$mtime2" ]; then
    echo "  mtime: MATCH ($mtime1)";
  else
    echo "  mtime: DIFFER (original:$mtime1 normalized:$mtime2)"; diff_flag=1;
  fi
  if [ "$perm1" = "$perm2" ]; then
    echo "  permissions: MATCH ($perm1)";
  else
    echo "  permissions: DIFFER (original:$perm1 normalized:$perm2)"; diff_flag=1;
  fi

  if [ $diff_flag -eq 0 ] && [ "$cc1" = "$cc2" ]; then
    echo "Conclusion: normalized file is identical to copy (no content/metadata changes).";
  else
    echo "Conclusion: differences detected as noted above.";
  fi
} > temp_inspect/verification_report.txt

# 8. Create summary ready_to_count.txt listing normalized file path and all verification artifacts
normalized_path=$(realpath temp_inspect/matrix_normalized.txt)
cat > temp_inspect/ready_to_count.txt <<EOF
normalized_file: $normalized_path
artifacts:
  - temp_inspect/matrix_copy.txt
  - temp_inspect/matrix_normalized.txt
  - temp_inspect/matrix_copy.meta
  - temp_inspect/matrix_normalized.meta
  - temp_inspect/matrix_copy.checksum
  - temp_inspect/matrix_normalized.checksum
  - temp_inspect/preview_head.txt
  - temp_inspect/preview_tail.txt
  - temp_inspect/verification_report.txt
status: ready for final line count
EOF

# Finally, output the number of lines in /root/matrix.txt (single number)
wc -l < /root/matrix.txt
"}
